description: Bornes de recharge pour - Parking EFFIA is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Parking EFFIA Stationnement. List of recharging points for electric vehicles in EFFIA car parks. For more information, please visit our website: ICI. Coverage: Parking EFFIA Stationnement. The portal shows the English title as "Charging stations for electric vehicles - Parking EFFIA" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Parking EFFIA Stationnement. Its keywords include station-de-charge, parking-public, voiture-electrique, vehicules-electriques, bornes-de-recharge, irve. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XLS, CSV. The listing shows 2023-12-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
